The following events took place in approximately '''11,791 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Crusade of the Wilds]] occurs. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], under the control of the [[Pius Dea]] religious cult and the [[Contispex dynasty]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellors]], begin a military invasion of the northern [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] against various alien species.<ref name="EGW" />
